characters.doge.name: Doge
characters.doge.ability: Twice per game, when attacked, roll a die. On even, take no damage.
characters.doge.winCondition: You survive until another player reaches their Win Condition.
characters.payToWin.name: Pay-to-Win
characters.payToWin.ability: When you would deal 2 or more damage, you may steal an Equipment card from your target instead.
characters.payToWin.winCondition: You possess 5 or more Equipment cards.
characters.johnWick.name: John Wick
characters.johnWick.ability: After attacking, you may take 2 damage to attack again.
characters.johnWick.winCondition: Your attack kills a character and that kill puts the total body count at 3 or more.
characters.pressF.name: Press F
characters.pressF.ability: When a character dies, reveal your Character card.
characters.pressF.winCondition: You are the first character to die, or you survive and the Memers achieve their Win Condition.
characters.parkourGuy.name: Parkour Guy
characters.parkourGuy.ability: When moving, you may move to an adjacent Area instead of rolling the dice.
characters.deathNote.name: DEATH NOTE
characters.deathNote.ability: Once per game, you may deal damage to any player equal to a 6-sided die roll.
characters.hadouken.name: Hadouken!
characters.hadouken.ability: Once per game, you may deal damage to any player equal to a 4-sided die roll.
characters.pokerFace.name: Poker Face
characters.pokerFace.ability: When given a Notification, you may lie without revealing your identity.
characters.pokerFace.winCondition: All Memers are dead, or 3 Users are dead.
characters.lifeStonks.name: Life Stonks
characters.lifeStonks.ability: When you attack a player and deal damage, you may heal 2 HP.
characters.lifeStonks.winCondition: All Memers are dead, or 3 Users are dead.
characters.surpriseMf.name: Surprise MF
characters.surpriseMf.ability: After being attacked, you may immediately attack your attacker.
characters.surpriseMf.winCondition: All Memers are dead, or 3 Users are dead.
areas.otakusParadise.name: Otaku's Paradise
areas.otakusParadise.effect: Draw 1 Notification, read it, then give it to another player.
areas.bedOfYourDreams.name: The Bed of Your Dreams
areas.bedOfYourDreams.effect: Draw 1 White card and follow its instructions.
areas.grandmasNewBedroom.name: Grandma's New Bedroom
areas.grandmasNewBedroom.effect: Draw 1 Black card and follow its instructions.
areas.atticHatch.name: Attic Hatch
areas.atticHatch.effect: Choose a White, Black, or Notification deck. Draw 1 card and follow its instructions.
areas.toxicRelationship.name: Toxic Relationship
areas.toxicRelationship.effect: Choose a player: deal 2 damage or heal 1 HP. You may choose yourself.
areas.pickpocketBoulevard.name: Pickpocket Boulevard
areas.pickpocketBoulevard.effect: Take 1 Equipment card from another player. Nothing happens if no one has Equipment.
cards.notifications.grandpasAdvice.name: Grandpa's Advice
cards.notifications.grandpasAdvice.text: Memer: Heal 1 HP, or take 1 damage if at full HP.
cards.notifications.unsolicitedLifeAdvic: User: Heal 1 HP, or take 1 damage if at full HP.
cards.notifications.getOverHere.name: Get Over Here
cards.notifications.getOverHere.text: Troller: Heal 1 HP, or take 1 damage if at full HP.
cards.notifications.payMeOrElse.name: Pay Me or Else
cards.notifications.payMeOrElse.text: Memer or User: Give 1 Equipment card to the current player, or take 1 damage.
cards.notifications.unresolvedIssues.tex: Memer or Troller: Give 1 Equipment card to the current player, or take 1 damage.
cards.notifications.taxCollection.name: Tax Collection
cards.notifications.taxCollection.text: User or Troller: Give 1 Equipment card to the current player, or take 1 damage.
cards.notifications.bonk.name: Bonk
cards.notifications.bonk.text: If you are a Memer, take 1 damage.
cards.notifications.emotionalAltF4.name: Emotional ALT+F4
cards.notifications.emotionalAltF4.text: If you are a Troller, take 1 damage.
cards.notifications.restInPiss.name: Rest in Piss
cards.notifications.restInPiss.text: If you are a Troller, take 2 damage.
cards.notifications.skillIssue.name: Skill Issue
cards.notifications.skillIssue.text: If you have 11 HP or less, take 1 damage.
cards.notifications.characterDevelopment: If you have 12 HP or more, take 2 damage.
cards.notifications.spoilerAlert.name: Spoiler Alert
cards.notifications.spoilerAlert.text: Reveal your Character card to the current player.
cards.white.judgementBeam.name: Judgement Beam
cards.white.judgementBeam.text: All characters except you take 2 damage.
cards.white.emotionalDamage.name: EMOTIONAL DAMAGE.
cards.white.forbiddenGoogleSearch.name: Forbidden Google Search
cards.white.forbiddenGoogleSearch.text: After this turn ends, you immediately take another turn.
cards.white.personalBodyguard.name: Personal Bodyguard
cards.white.personalBodyguard.text: You take no damage from attacks by other characters until the start of your next turn.
cards.white.ctrlZEnchantment.name: Ctrl+Z this Enchantment
cards.white.ctrlZEnchantment.text: If your character's name begins with V or W, you must reveal your identity.
cards.white.devineJuice.name: Devine Juice
cards.white.plusOneFromGod.name: +1 from god
cards.white.plusOneFromGod.text: Choose a character other than yourself and roll a 6-sided die. That character heals the amount of HP shown on the die.
cards.white.therapySnack.name: Therapy Snack
cards.white.therapySnack.text: If your character's name begins with A, E, or U, you may reveal your identity. If you do, restore your HP to full.
cards.white.christmasDlc.name: Christmas DLC
cards.white.christmasDlc.text: If you are a Memer, you may reveal your identity. If you do, restore your HP to full.
cards.black.bloodthirstyFlyingRat.name: Bloodthirsty Flying Rat
cards.black.bloodthirstyFlyingRat.text: Deal 2 damage to any character and heal 1 HP.
cards.black.gimmeThat.name: Gimme That
cards.black.gimmeThat.text: Steal an Equipment card from any character.
cards.black.borrowingWithoutAsking.name: Borrowing Without Asking
cards.black.borrowingWithoutAsking.text: Steal an Equipment card from any character.
cards.black.mischievousSpider.name: Mischievous Spider
cards.black.mischievousSpider.text: Deal 2 damage to any character and take 2 damage yourself.
cards.black.authenticVoodooDoll.name: Authentic Voodoo Doll
cards.black.authenticVoodooDoll.text: Choose any character and roll a 6-sided die. On 1-4, deal 3 damage to that character. On 5-6, take 3 damage yourself.
cards.black.explosiveStick.name: Explosive Stick
cards.black.explosiveStick.text: Roll both dice and deal 3 damage to all characters in the Area corresponding to the total rolled. Nothing happens on a 7.
cards.black.notABananaPeel.name: Not a Banana Peel
cards.black.notABananaPeel.text: Give one of your Equipment cards to another character. If you have no Equipment cards, take 1 damage.
cards.black.questionableLifeChoices.name: Questionable Life Choices
cards.black.questionableLifeChoices.text: If you are a Troller, you may reveal your identity. If you do, restore your HP to full.
cards.equipment.luckExe.name: Luck.exe
cards.equipment.luckExe.text: You take no damage from Toxic Relationship.
cards.equipment.suspiciousNecklace.name: Suspicious Necklace
cards.equipment.suspiciousNecklace.text: You take no damage from Mischievous Spider, Bloodthirsty Flying Rat, or Explosive Stick.
cards.equipment.googleMapsMedievalEditio: You may roll twice when moving and choose which result to use.
cards.equipment.godsHandSpinner.name: Gods' Hand Spinner
cards.equipment.godsHandSpinner.text: If you attack and kill another character, steal all of their Equipment cards.
cards.equipment.telescopicLance.name: Telescopic lance
cards.equipment.telescopicLance.text: If you are a Memer and your attack is successful, you may reveal your identity. If you do, your attack deals 2 additional damage.
cards.equipment.jesusLastPajamas.name: Jesus' Last Pajamas
cards.equipment.jesusLastPajamas.text: You MUST attack as soon as possible. Your attacks are made with a single roll of a 4-sided die and cannot fail.
cards.equipment.sharkTeeth.name: Shark Teeth on a Motorized Shaft
cards.equipment.sharkTeeth.text: On a successful attack, deal 1 additional damage.
cards.equipment.freeCircumcision.name: Free Circumcision
cards.equipment.freeCircumcision.text: On a successful attack, deal 1 additional damage.
cards.equipment.plankRustyNails.name: Plank with Rusty Nails
cards.equipment.plankRustyNails.text: On a successful attack, deal 1 additional damage.
cards.equipment.pfrtTube.name: A PFRFRFRFRFRFRFRFRRT Tube
cards.equipment.pfrtTube.text: Your attacks target all characters within your attack range. Roll the dice once and apply the same damage to all affected characters.
cards.equipment.fingerBullet.name: Finger Bullet
cards.equipment.fingerBullet.text: Your attack range becomes every Area except your own.
cards.equipment.cursedJapaneseChopsticks: You MUST attack if possible. Your attacks are made with a single roll of a 4-sided die and cannot fail.
ui.tagHint: Drag a tag onto a player, or tap the tag then the player. Only you can see them.

lobby.guestWaiting: Connected to host. Waiting for the host to start the match.
